gloss: is nothing but; is none other than

definitions.gloss: is nothing but; is none other than; is precisely
definitions.explanation: Fixed pattern used to emphatically identify one thing as the sole or true essence of another. Frequently used in formal writing, essays, and speeches to make a definitive claim.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧にほかならない。
examples.english: The secret to success is nothing but effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧にほかならない。
examples.english: This is nothing less than our victory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧にほかならない。
examples.english: His words were none other than the truth that gave courage to many people.

notes:
Emphatic identifying pattern formed from ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + ⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ (literally 'is not other than'). Used to insist that X is precisely Y, no other interpretation possible.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun] + にほかならない
- Often appears at the end of an explanatory sentence summing up a cause, identity, or essence.

REGISTER:
Formal and emphatic. Common in essays, editorials, academic writing, and speeches. In casual conversation, ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧〜だ or 〜⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧〜だ is more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: is nothing more than — downplays the subject (negative emphasis)
- 〜⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧〜だ: ~ is precisely ~ — similar emphasis, less formal
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧〜だ: truly is ~ — adverbial emphasis, more conversational
